title: Cindy
creator: CrossFit
description: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of 5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups and 15 squats. Posted in December 2004, it is the most repeated CrossFit benchmark and needs only a pull-up bar. Scale to ring rows and knee push-ups, or a 12-minute 3-6-9 version for beginners.
